title: jk.toml
description: JumpKick project manifest. Top-level identity and language keys, the core tables, and the dependency scopes. Plugin-owned tables ([micronaut], [android], ...) are allowed and documented by their plugins.

name.description: Module identity; never inherited from the workspace.

group.description: Maven groupId, or { workspace = true } in a member.

version.description: Version string, or { workspace = true } in a member.

sources.description: Source roots beyond the standard layout.

repositories.description: [repositories] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

profiles.description: [profiles] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

features.description: [features] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

workspace.description: [workspace] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

manifest.description: [manifest] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

plugins.description: [plugins] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

native.description: [native] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

image.description: [image] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

train.description: [train] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

build.description: [build] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

test.description: [test] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

format.description: [format] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

resolve.description: [resolve] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

variants.description: [variants] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

jvm.description: [jvm] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

deny.description: [deny] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

guards.description: [guards] table: on-build (default true) moves the module and workspace guard lanes to --gate when false; coverage-report names the coverage XML the coverage.* measures read. Rules live in jk-guards.toml.

config.description: [config] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

forge.description: [forge] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

kotlin-plugins.description: [kotlin-plugins] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

m2.description: [m2] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

install.description: [install] table; keys are documented in docs/user.

export-dependencies.description: [export-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

dependencies.description: [dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

provided-dependencies.description: [provided-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

runtime-dependencies.description: [runtime-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

test-dependencies.description: [test-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

processor-dependencies.description: [processor-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

platform-dependencies.description: [platform-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

dev-dependencies.description: [dev-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

test-dev-dependencies.description: [test-dev-dependencies]: one dependency per key — a version string, or { group, name, version, features, ... }.

inherit.description: Cargo-style inheritance from the workspace root.
